verdict.rationale: AWS states that the CLI implements functionality equivalent to the browser-based Management Console. It also documents scripted control of multiple services, and console credentials can be reused programmatically via 'aws login'. Full resource provisioning and teardown is available through CloudFormation and the CDK, and billing data is queryable via the Cost Explorer API. Missing for 10: a documented guarantee that every console feature has an API counterpart, independent or hands-on corroboration of that parity, and a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404).
